mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000, the labor market's dual signal predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 105 indicates supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns falls below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding 5% month-over-month signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of months with RSAFS growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL inflation above 3% and FEDFUNDS rate below 2% create a policy mismatch, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST readings below 1000 indicate reduced housing demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: UNRATE's level provides a persistent labor market signal, with lower rates generally associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 58% of weeks with UNRATE below 5%.
